title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Implementing the Revised Guiding Opinions on Sentencing for Common Crimes
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Implementing the Revised Guiding Opinions on Sentencing for Common Crimes

Fa Fa [2017] No. 7

To the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Guiding Opinions on Sentencing for Common Crimes of the Supreme People's Court has been formally implemented in intermediate and basic people's courts nationwide since 2014. All high people's courts have attached great importance to it, actively and steadily organized its implementation, and achieved good results. On the basis of summarizing practical experience, our Court has further revised and improved the Sentencing Guiding Opinions. The revised Guiding Opinions on Sentencing for Common Crimes (hereinafter referred to as the Sentencing Guiding Opinions) are hereby issued and shall be implemented as of April 1, 2017. The relevant matters are notified as follows:

(I) Carefully revise the implementing rules. The Sentencing Guiding Opinions further improve the sentencing method, clarifying the sentencing method of "qualitative analysis as the primary method, quantitative analysis as the supplementary method"; further revise and improve the application of common sentencing circumstances and the sentencing norms for specific crimes. All high people's courts shall earnestly study and comprehend, on the basis of summarizing experience, in conjunction with newly promulgated criminal laws, judicial interpretations, professional guidance documents, and trial practice, compare and revise the implementing rules to ensure that the implementing rules are legally grounded, conform to the principle of proportionality between crime, responsibility, and punishment, conform to sentencing reality, and are operable. The implementing rules shall be implemented after being discussed and adopted by the Judicial Committee and shall be reported to the Supreme People's Court for record before the end of April.

(II) Comprehensively and deeply organize implementation. The work of standardizing sentencing is a long-term task. People's courts at all levels shall take this revision of the Sentencing Guiding Opinions and the implementing rules as an opportunity to earnestly summarize experience, comprehensively and deeply advance the work of standardizing sentencing, bring all 15 types of common crimes within the scope of standardization, and ensure full implementation in all intermediate and basic people's courts. In combination with trial practice, they shall proactively align with the reform of the trial-centered criminal procedure system, the reform of the leniency system for confession and acceptance of punishment, and the reform of the summary criminal procedure, establish and improve a long-term working mechanism for standardizing sentencing, promote the institutionalization and normalization of sentencing standardization work, and strive to let the people feel fairness and justice in every judicial case.

(III) Effectively strengthen training and guidance. The Sentencing Guiding Opinions have made important revisions to sentencing methods and other content. Courts in all regions shall, in light of their actual work, strengthen professional training for judges handling cases in intermediate and basic people's courts, especially newly appointed judges, to ensure the correct implementation of the Sentencing Guiding Opinions and the implementing rules. In the sentencing process, qualitative analysis shall always occupy a dominant position. Quantitative analysis shall be conducted on the basis of qualitative analysis, determining the starting point of sentencing, the baseline sentence, and the pronounced sentence according to law, ensuring proportionality between crime, responsibility, and punishment. Higher-level courts shall effectively strengthen investigation and guidance, promptly study and resolve new situations and problems that arise during implementation, and continuously summarize and improve. Major difficult problems encountered during implementation shall be reported level by level to the Supreme People's Court in a timely manner to ensure the sustained and in-depth development of sentencing standardization work.

March 9, 2017

Guiding Opinions on Sentencing for Common Crimes

To further standardize the discretion of punishment, implement the criminal policy of combining leniency and strictness, enhance the transparency of sentencing, and achieve sentencing justice, these Guiding Opinions are formulated in accordance with the Criminal Law, criminal judicial interpretations, and other relevant provisions, in light of trial practice.

I. Guiding Principles for Sentencing

1. Sentencing shall be based on facts and take law as the criterion. The punishment to be imposed shall be determined according to the facts, nature, circumstances of the crime and the degree of harm to society.

2. Sentencing shall consider both the severity of the crime committed by the defendant and the degree of criminal responsibility the defendant should bear, achieving proportionality between crime, responsibility, and punishment, and realizing the purposes of punishing and preventing crime.

3. Sentencing shall implement the criminal policy of combining leniency and strictness, achieving leniency when leniency is due, strictness when strictness is due, combining leniency and strictness, and making the punishment fit the crime, ensuring the unity of the legal effect and social effect of the judgment.

4. Sentencing shall objectively and comprehensively grasp the changes in economic and social development and public security situations in different periods and regions, ensuring the realization of the tasks of the Criminal Law; for cases with similar facts in the same region and same period, the punishments imposed shall be substantially balanced.

II. Basic Methods of Sentencing

When sentencing, qualitative analysis shall be the primary method, supplemented by quantitative analysis. The starting point of sentencing, the baseline sentence, and the pronounced sentence shall be determined in sequence.

1. Steps of Sentencing

(1) Determine the starting point of sentencing within the corresponding statutory punishment range based on the basic facts constituting the crime.

(2) Based on other criminal facts that affect the constitution of the crime, such as the amount of crime, number of crimes, consequences of crime, increase the amount of punishment on the basis of the starting point of sentencing to determine the baseline sentence.

(3) Adjust the baseline sentence according to sentencing circumstances, and comprehensively consider the overall circumstances of the case to determine the pronounced sentence according to law.

2. Methods of Adjusting the Baseline Sentence

(1) If there is a single sentencing circumstance, adjust the baseline sentence directly according to the adjustment ratio of that sentencing circumstance.

(2) If there are multiple sentencing circumstances, generally adjust the baseline sentence using the method of adding for same direction and subtracting for opposite direction according to the adjustment ratios of each sentencing circumstance; if there are sentencing circumstances such as juvenile delinquency, elderly delinquency, crime by a mentally ill person with limited capacity, crime by a deaf-mute or blind person, excessive defense, excessive necessity, criminal preparation, criminal attempt, criminal suspension, accomplices, coerced accomplices, and abettors, first apply those sentencing circumstances to adjust the baseline sentence, and on that basis, apply other sentencing circumstances to adjust.

(3) If the defendant commits multiple crimes and has sentencing circumstances such as meritorious service or recidivism that apply to each crime, first apply those sentencing circumstances to adjust the baseline sentence of each crime, determine the punishment to be imposed for each crime, then implement combined punishment for multiple crimes according to law to determine the executed punishment.

3. Methods of Determining the Pronounced Sentence

(1) If the result of adjusting the baseline sentence by sentencing circumstances is within the statutory punishment range and the crime, responsibility, and punishment are proportional, it may be directly determined as the pronounced sentence; if there is a circumstance of statutory mitigation of punishment, the pronounced sentence shall be determined below the statutory minimum punishment according to law.

(2) If the result of adjusting the baseline sentence by sentencing circumstances is below the statutory minimum punishment, and there is a statutory circumstance for mitigating punishment, and the crime, responsibility, and punishment are proportional, it may be directly determined as the pronounced sentence; if there is only a circumstance for lenient punishment, the statutory minimum punishment may be determined as the pronounced sentence according to law; however, under special circumstances of the case, with the approval of the Supreme People's Court, punishment may also be imposed below the statutory punishment.

(3) If the result of adjusting the baseline sentence by sentencing circumstances is above the statutory maximum punishment, the statutory maximum punishment may be determined as the pronounced sentence according to law.

(4) Comprehensively considering the overall circumstances of the case, a single-judge panel or collegial panel may adjust the result within a range of 20% to determine the pronounced sentence. If the adjusted result still does not conform to the principle of proportionality between crime, responsibility, and punishment, it shall be submitted to the Judicial Committee for discussion and determination of the pronounced sentence according to law.

(5) Comprehensively considering the entire criminal facts and sentencing circumstances of the case, if a sentence of fixed-term imprisonment of life imprisonment or above, public surveillance, a supplementary punishment alone, probation, or exemption from punishment should be imposed according to law, such shall be imposed according to law.

III. Application of Common Sentencing Circumstances

When sentencing, full consideration shall be given to various statutory and discretionary sentencing circumstances. According to all criminal facts of the case and different situations of sentencing circumstances, the application of sentencing circumstances and their adjustment ratios shall be determined according to law. For serious violent crimes, drug crimes, and other crimes that seriously endanger social order, the scope of leniency shall be strictly controlled; for crimes with lighter circumstances, leniency shall be fully reflected. When specifically determining the adjustment ratio of each sentencing circumstance, the relationship between the adjustment range and the actual increase or decrease in the amount of punishment shall be comprehensively balanced to ensure proportionality between crime, responsibility, and punishment.

1. For juvenile delinquency, the circumstances shall be comprehensively considered, including the juvenile's ability to understand the crime, the motive and purpose of committing the crime, age at the time of the crime, whether it is a first offense or occasional offense, expression of remorse, personal growth experience, and consistent behavior, and leniency shall be granted.

(1) For a juvenile aged 14 to 16 who commits a crime, the baseline sentence shall be reduced by 30%-60%.

(2) For a juvenile aged 16 to 18 who commits a crime, the baseline sentence shall be reduced by 10%-50%.

2. For an attempted offender, comprehensively considering the degree of implementation of the criminal act, the extent of harm caused, the reason for the crime not being completed, and other circumstances, the baseline sentence may be reduced by up to 50% compared to a completed offender.

3. For an accomplice, comprehensively considering its status and role in the joint crime and other circumstances, leniency shall be granted, and the baseline sentence shall be reduced by 20%-50%; if the crime is relatively minor, the baseline sentence shall be reduced by 50% or more, or punishment shall be exempted according to law.

4. For the circumstance of voluntary surrender, comprehensively considering the motive, timing, method, severity of the crime, degree of truthful confession of the crime, and expression of remorse, the baseline sentence may be reduced by up to 40%; if the crime is relatively minor, the baseline sentence may be reduced by 40% or more, or punishment may be exempted according to law. Except where the person maliciously uses voluntary surrender to evade legal sanctions and is not deserving of leniency.

5. For the circumstance of truthful confession, comprehensively considering the stage, degree, severity of the crime, and degree of remorse of the truthful confession, the scope of leniency shall be determined.

(1) If the person truthfully confesses his own crime, the baseline sentence may be reduced by up to 20%.

(2) If the person truthfully confesses a more serious crime of the same type not yet known to the judicial organs, the baseline sentence may be reduced by 10%-30%.

(3) If truthful confession of one's own crime avoids particularly serious consequences, the baseline sentence may be reduced by 30%-50%.

6. For voluntary guilty plea in court, according to the nature of the crime, severity of the crime, degree of admission of guilt, and expression of remorse, the baseline sentence may be reduced by up to 10%. Except where voluntary surrender or truthful confession is legally determined.

7. For the circumstance of meritorious service, comprehensively considering the size, number, content, source, effect of the meritorious service, and the severity of the crime, the scope of leniency shall be determined.

(1) For ordinary meritorious service, the baseline sentence may be reduced by up to 20%.

(2) For major meritorious service, the baseline sentence may be reduced by 20%-50%; if the crime is relatively minor, the baseline sentence shall be reduced by 50% or more, or punishment shall be exempted according to law.

8. For restitution of stolen goods or compensation for losses, comprehensively considering the nature of the crime, the degree to which the act of restitution or compensation can remedy the harmful result, the amount and degree of initiative of restitution or compensation, the baseline sentence may be reduced by up to 30%; for crimes that seriously endanger social order such as robbery, it shall be strictly controlled.

9. For actively compensating the victim's economic losses and obtaining forgiveness, comprehensively considering the nature of the crime, the amount of compensation, the ability to compensate, and the degree of admission of guilt and remorse, the baseline sentence may be reduced by up to 40%; for active compensation without obtaining forgiveness, the baseline sentence may be reduced by up to 30%; for no compensation but obtaining forgiveness, the baseline sentence may be reduced by up to 20%. For crimes that seriously endanger social order such as robbery and rape, it shall be strictly controlled.

10. For a criminal settlement agreement reached by the parties pursuant to Article 277 of the Criminal Procedure Law, comprehensively considering the nature of the crime, the amount of compensation, apology, and sincere remorse, the baseline sentence may be reduced by up to 50%; if the crime is relatively minor, the baseline sentence shall be reduced by 50% or more, or punishment shall be exempted according to law.

11. For a recidivist, comprehensively considering the nature of the previous and subsequent crimes, the length of time between the completion of the previous punishment or pardon and the recommission of the crime, and the severity of the previous and subsequent crimes, the baseline sentence shall be increased by 10%-40%, generally not less than 3 months.

12. For a person with a criminal record, comprehensively considering the nature of the previous record, the length of time interval, the number of records, and the severity of the punishment, the baseline sentence may be increased by up to 10%. Except where the previous crime was a negligent crime or a crime committed as a juvenile.

13. If the target of the crime is a vulnerable person such as a minor, an elderly person, a disabled person, or a pregnant woman, comprehensively considering the nature of the crime and the severity of the crime, the baseline sentence may be increased by up to 20%.

14. For intentional crimes committed during major natural disasters, prevention and control of sudden infectious disease epidemics, and other disasters, according to the specific circumstances of the case, the baseline sentence may be increased by up to 20%.

IV. Sentencing for Common Crimes

(A) Crime of Causing a Traffic Accident

1. For constituting the crime of causing a traffic accident, the starting point of sentencing may be determined within the corresponding range according to the following different circumstances:

(1) If it causes serious injury or death or causes major loss to public or private property, the starting point of sentencing may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of not more than 2 years or criminal detention.

(2) If the person flees after causing a traffic accident or if there are other especially heinous circumstances, the starting point of sentencing may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of 3 to 5 years.

(3) If the flight results in the death of one person, the starting point of sentencing may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of 7 to 10 years.

2. On the basis of the starting point of sentencing, the amount of punishment may be increased according to other criminal facts that affect the constitution of the crime, such as the degree of responsibility for the accident, the number of persons seriously injured or killed, or the amount of property loss, and flight, to determine the baseline sentence.

(B) Crime of Intentional Injury

1. For constituting the crime of intentional injury, the starting point of sentencing may be determined within the corresponding range according to the following different circumstances:

(1) If intentional injury causes minor injury to one person, the starting point of sentencing may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of not more than 2 years or criminal detention.

(2) If intentional injury causes serious injury to one person, the starting point of sentencing may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of 3 to 5 years.

(3) If intentional injury causing serious injury to one person by especially cruel means results in a Class 6 severe disability, the starting point of sentencing may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of 10 to 13 years. Except where a sentence of fixed-term imprisonment of life imprisonment or above should be imposed according to law.

2. On the basis of the starting point of sentencing, the amount of punishment may be increased according to other criminal facts that affect the constitution of the crime, such as the consequences of the injury, the grade of disability, and the degree of cruelty of the means, to determine the baseline sentence.

For intentional injury causing minor injury, the degree of disability may be considered when determining the starting point of sentencing or as a sentencing circumstance to adjust the baseline sentence.

(C) Crime of Rape

1. For constituting the crime of rape, the starting point of sentencing may be determined within the corresponding range according to the following different circumstances:

(1) If one woman is raped, the starting point of sentencing may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of 3 to 6 years.

If one female child is raped, the starting point of sentencing may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of 4 to 7 years.

(2) If any of the following circumstances exist, the starting point of sentencing may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of 10 to 13 years: rape of a woman or female child under heinous circumstances; rape of three women or female children; rape of a woman in a public place in front of others; gang rape of a woman by two or more persons; rape causing serious injury to the victim or other serious consequences. Except where a sentence of fixed-term imprisonment of life imprisonment or above should be imposed according to law.

2. On the basis of the starting point of sentencing, the amount of punishment may be increased according to other criminal facts that affect the constitution of the crime, such as the heinousness of the circumstances of rape of a woman or female child, the number of persons raped, and the consequences of injury caused, to determine the baseline sentence.

For multiple counts of rape of multiple persons, the number of persons raped shall be the fact for increasing the amount of punishment, and the number of times of rape shall be the sentencing circumstance for adjusting the baseline sentence.

(D) Crime of Unlawful Detention

1. For constituting the crime of unlawful detention, the starting point of sentencing may be determined within the corresponding range according to the following different circumstances:

(1) If the circumstances of the crime are ordinary, the starting point of sentencing may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of not more than 1 year or criminal detention.

(2) If it causes serious injury to one person, the starting point of sentencing may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of 3 to 5 years.

(3) If it causes the death of one person, the starting point of sentencing may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of 10 to 13 years.

2. On the basis of the starting point of sentencing, the amount of punishment may be increased according to other criminal facts that affect the constitution of the crime, such as the number of persons unlawfully detained, the duration of detention, and the consequences of injury or death caused, to determine the baseline sentence.

For multiple counts of unlawful detention of multiple persons, the number of persons unlawfully detained shall be the fact for increasing the amount of punishment, and the number of times of unlawful detention shall be the sentencing circumstance for adjusting the baseline sentence.

3. If any of the following circumstances exist, the baseline sentence may be increased by 10%-20%:

(1) If there are circumstances of beating or insulting;
(2) If a state functionary unlawfully detains or imprisons another person by abusing his authority.

(E) Crime of Robbery

1. For constituting the crime of robbery, the starting point of sentencing may be determined within the corresponding range according to the following different circumstances:

(1) If robbery is committed once, the starting point of sentencing may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of 3 to 6 years.

(2) If any of the following circumstances exist, the starting point of sentencing may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of 10 to 13 years: robbery in a dwelling; robbery on a public transportation vehicle; robbery of a bank or any other financial institution; robbery three times or the amount of robbery reaches the starting point for a huge amount; robbery causing serious injury to one person; robbery by impersonating a military or police officer; robbery with a firearm; robbery of military supplies or materials for emergency rescue, disaster relief, or relief. Except where a sentence of fixed-term imprisonment of life imprisonment or above should be imposed according to law.

2. On the basis of the starting point of sentencing, the amount of punishment may be increased according to other criminal facts that affect the constitution of the crime, such as the severity of the robbery circumstances, the number of robberies, the amount, and the consequences of injury caused, to determine the baseline sentence.

(F) Crime of Theft

1. For constituting the crime of theft, the starting point of sentencing may be determined within the corresponding range according to the following different circumstances:

(1) If the amount reaches the starting point for a relatively large amount, theft three times within two years, theft in a dwelling, theft with a dangerous weapon, or pickpocketing, the starting point of sentencing may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of not more than 1 year or criminal detention.

(2) If the amount reaches the starting point for a huge amount or if there are other serious circumstances, the starting point of sentencing may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of 3 to 4 years.

(3) If the amount reaches the starting point for an especially huge amount or if there are other especially serious circumstances, the starting point of sentencing may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of 10 to 12 years. Except where a sentence of fixed-term imprisonment of life imprisonment should be imposed according to law.

2. On the basis of the starting point of sentencing, the amount of punishment may be increased according to other criminal facts that affect the constitution of the crime, such as the amount of theft, number of times, and means, to determine the baseline sentence.

For multiple thefts, if the amount reaches the threshold for a relatively large amount or above, the starting point of sentencing shall be determined by the amount of theft, and the number of thefts may be used as a sentencing circumstance to adjust the baseline sentence; if the amount does not reach the threshold for a relatively large amount, the starting point of sentencing shall be determined by the number of thefts, and the number of times exceeding three shall be the fact for increasing the amount of punishment.

(G) Crime of Fraud

1. For constituting the crime of fraud, the starting point of sentencing may be determined within the corresponding range according to the following different circumstances:

(1) If the amount reaches the starting point for a relatively large amount, the starting point of sentencing may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of not more than 1 year or criminal detention.

(2) If the amount reaches the starting point for a huge amount or if there are other serious circumstances, the starting point of sentencing may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of 3 to 4 years.

(3) If the amount reaches the starting point for an especially huge amount or if there are other especially serious circumstances, the starting point of sentencing may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of 10 to 12 years. Except where a sentence of fixed-term imprisonment of life imprisonment should be imposed according to law.

2. On the basis of the starting point of sentencing, the amount of punishment may be increased according to other criminal facts that affect the constitution of the crime, such as the amount of fraud, to determine the baseline sentence.

(H) Crime of Snatching

1. For those who commit the crime of snatching, the sentencing starting point may be determined within the corresponding range according to the following different circumstances:

(1) If the threshold for a relatively large amount is reached, or there are three acts of snatching within two years, the sentencing starting point may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of not more than one year or criminal detention.

(2) If the threshold for a huge amount is reached, or there are other serious circumstances, the sentencing starting point may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of three to five years.

(3) If the threshold for an especially huge amount is reached, or there are other especially serious circumstances, the sentencing starting point may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of ten to twelve years. Except where life imprisonment should be imposed according to law.

2. On the basis of the sentencing starting point, the amount of punishment may be increased based on other criminal facts affecting the constitution of the crime, such as the amount and frequency of snatching, and the baseline sentence shall be determined.

Where there are multiple acts of snatching and the amount reaches the relatively large level or above, the sentencing starting point shall be determined by the snatching amount, and the number of snatching acts may be used as a sentencing circumstance to adjust the baseline sentence; where the amount does not reach the relatively large level, the sentencing starting point shall be determined by the number of snatching acts, and the number of acts exceeding three shall be used as a fact to increase the amount of punishment.

(9) Crime of Embezzlement

1. For those who commit the crime of embezzlement, the sentencing starting point may be determined within the corresponding range according to the following different circumstances:

(1) If the threshold for a relatively large amount is reached, the sentencing starting point may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of not more than two years or criminal detention.

(2) If the threshold for a huge amount is reached, the sentencing starting point may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of five to six years.

2. On the basis of the sentencing starting point, the amount of punishment may be increased based on other criminal facts affecting the constitution of the crime, such as the amount of embezzlement, and the baseline sentence shall be determined.

(10) Crime of Extortion

1. For those who commit the crime of extortion, the sentencing starting point may be determined within the corresponding range according to the following different circumstances:

(1) If the threshold for a relatively large amount is reached, or there are three acts of extortion within two years, the sentencing starting point may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of not more than one year or criminal detention.

(2) If the threshold for a huge amount is reached, or there are other serious circumstances, the sentencing starting point may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of three to five years.

(3) If the threshold for an especially huge amount is reached, or there are other especially serious circumstances, the sentencing starting point may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of ten to twelve years.

2. On the basis of the sentencing starting point, the amount of punishment may be increased based on other criminal facts affecting the constitution of the crime, such as the amount and frequency of extortion, the severity of the criminal circumstances, and the baseline sentence shall be determined.

Where there are multiple acts of extortion and the amount reaches the relatively large level or above, the sentencing starting point shall be determined by the extortion amount, and the number of extortion acts may be used as a sentencing circumstance to adjust the baseline sentence; where the amount does not reach the relatively large level, the sentencing starting point shall be determined by the number of extortion acts, and the number of acts exceeding three shall be used as a fact to increase the amount of punishment.

(11) Crime of Obstructing Official Duties

1. For those who commit the crime of obstructing official duties, the sentencing starting point may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of not more than two years or criminal detention.

2. On the basis of the sentencing starting point, the amount of punishment may be increased based on other criminal facts affecting the constitution of the crime, such as the consequences caused by obstructing official duties, the severity of the criminal circumstances, and the baseline sentence shall be determined.

3. For violently assaulting a people's police officer who is lawfully performing his or her duties, the baseline sentence may be increased by 10% to 30%.

(12) Crime of Assembling a Crowd to Engage in Affray

1. For those who commit the crime of assembling a crowd to engage in affray, the sentencing starting point may be determined within the corresponding range according to the following different circumstances:

(1) If the criminal circumstances are ordinary, the sentencing starting point may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of not more than two years or criminal detention.

(2) In any of the following circumstances, the sentencing starting point may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of three to five years: assembling a crowd to engage in affray three times; assembling a crowd to engage in affray with a large number of participants, on a large scale, and with adverse social impact; assembling a crowd to engage in affray in a public place or on a major traffic route, causing serious chaos in social order; or assembling a crowd to engage in affray while carrying weapons.

2. On the basis of the sentencing starting point, the amount of punishment may be increased based on other criminal facts affecting the constitution of the crime, such as the number of participants in the affray, the number of times, the severity of the means, and the baseline sentence shall be determined.

(13) Crime of Picking Quarrels and Provoking Trouble

1. For those who commit the crime of picking quarrels and provoking trouble, the sentencing starting point may be determined within the corresponding range according to the following different circumstances:

(1) If the act of picking quarrels and provoking trouble occurs once, the sentencing starting point may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention.

(2) If a person gathers others to pick quarrels and provoke trouble three times (each time constituting a crime), seriously disrupting social order, the sentencing starting point may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of five to seven years.

2. On the basis of the sentencing starting point, the amount of punishment may be increased based on other criminal facts affecting the constitution of the crime, such as the number of times of picking quarrels and provoking trouble, the consequences of injury, the amount of property forcibly taken or arbitrarily damaged or occupied, and the baseline sentence shall be determined.

(14) Crime of Concealing or Disguising Criminal Proceeds and the Proceeds Thereof

1. For those who commit the crime of concealing or disguising criminal proceeds and the proceeds thereof, the sentencing starting point may be determined within the corresponding range according to the following different circumstances:

(1) If the criminal circumstances are ordinary, the sentencing starting point may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of not more than one year or criminal detention.

(2) If the circumstances are serious, the sentencing starting point may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of three to four years.

2. On the basis of the sentencing starting point, the amount of punishment may be increased based on other criminal facts affecting the constitution of the crime, such as the amount of the crime, and the baseline sentence shall be determined.

(15) Crime of Smuggling, Trafficking, Transporting, and Manufacturing Drugs

1. For those who commit the crime of smuggling, trafficking, transporting, and manufacturing drugs, the sentencing starting point may be determined within the corresponding range according to the following different circumstances:

(1) For smuggling, trafficking, transporting, or manufacturing 1,000 grams of opium, 50 grams of heroin or methamphetamine, or other drugs in quantities reaching the threshold for a large quantity, the sentencing starting point shall be fixed-term imprisonment of fifteen years. Except where a sentence of life imprisonment or above should be imposed according to law.

(2) For smuggling, trafficking, transporting, or manufacturing 200 grams of opium, 10 grams of heroin or methamphetamine, or other drugs in quantities reaching the threshold for a relatively large quantity, the sentencing starting point may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of seven to eight years.

(3) For smuggling, trafficking, transporting, or manufacturing less than 200 grams of opium, less than 10 grams of heroin or methamphetamine, or other small quantities of drugs, the sentencing starting point may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention; if the circumstances are serious, the sentencing starting point may be determined within the range of fixed-term imprisonment of three to four years.

2. On the basis of the sentencing starting point, the amount of punishment may be increased based on other criminal facts affecting the constitution of the crime, such as the number of drug crime incidents, the number of persons involved, the quantity of drugs, and the baseline sentence shall be determined.

3. In any of the following circumstances, the baseline sentence may be increased by 10% to 30%:

(1) Using or inciting minors to smuggle, traffic, transport, or manufacture drugs;

(2) Selling drugs to minors;

(3) Recidivism for drug crimes.

4. In any of the following circumstances, the baseline sentence may be reduced by up to 30%:

(1) Being employed to transport drugs;

(2) The drug content is obviously low;

(3) There is a circumstance of quantity inducement.

V. Supplementary Provisions

1. These Guiding Opinions regulate cases where the above fifteen types of crimes are punished with fixed-term imprisonment or criminal detention. For other cases where fixed-term imprisonment or criminal detention is imposed, sentencing may be standardized by reference to the guiding principles, basic methods, and the application rules for common sentencing circumstances.

2. Each Higher People's Court shall formulate implementation rules in light of local conditions.

3. These Guiding Opinions shall come into effect on April 1, 2017. The Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Implementing the Work of Standardizing Sentencing (Fa Fa [2013] No. 14) shall be simultaneously abolished.

4. Relevant provisions of the Criminal Law:

Article 133 [Crime of Causing a Traffic Accident] Whoever violates traffic and transport management regulations, thereby causing a major accident, resulting in serious injury or death, or causing heavy losses to public or private property, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention. Whoever causes a traffic accident and flees the scene or has other especially flagrant circumstances shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years. Whoever causes death due to fleeing shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than seven years.

Article 234 [Crime of Intentional Injury] Whoever intentionally injures the body of another shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance.

Whoever commits the crime in the preceding paragraph, causing serious injury to another, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years; whoever causes death or causes serious injury resulting in severe disability by particularly cruel means shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years, life imprisonment, or death. Where this Law provides otherwise, such provisions shall apply.

Article 236 [Crime of Rape] Whoever rapes a woman by violence, coercion, or other means shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years.

Whoever has sexual intercourse with a girl under the age of fourteen shall be deemed to have committed rape and shall be given a heavier punishment.

Whoever rapes a woman or has sexual intercourse with a young girl, in any of the following circumstances, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years, life imprisonment, or death:

(1) The circumstances are flagrant;

(2) Raping multiple women or young girls;

(3) Raping a woman in a public place in the presence of others;

(4) Raping by two or more persons in turn;

(5) Causing serious injury or death to the victim or causing other serious consequences.

Article 238 [Crime of Unlawful Detention] Whoever unlawfully detains another or unlawfully deprives another of his or her personal freedom by other means shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, public surveillance, or deprivation of political rights. Where there are acts of beating or insulting, a heavier punishment shall be imposed.

Whoever commits the crime in the preceding paragraph, causing serious injury to another, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years; whoever causes death shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years. Whoever uses violence to cause injury or death shall be convicted and punished in accordance with Articles 234 and 232 of this Law.

Whoever unlawfully detains or holds another for the purpose of recovering a debt shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding two paragraphs.

Where a functionary of a State organ commits any of the crimes in the preceding three paragraphs by abusing his or her powers, a heavier punishment shall be imposed in accordance with the provisions of the preceding three paragraphs.

Article 263 [Crime of Robbery] Whoever robs public or private property by violence, coercion, or other means shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined; in any of the following circumstances, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years, life imprisonment, or death, and shall also be fined or have his or her property confiscated:

(1) Entering a residence to commit robbery;

(2) Committing robbery on a public means of transport;

(3) Robbing a bank or any other financial institution;

(4) Committing robbery on multiple occasions or robbing a huge amount of property;

(5) Causing serious injury or death during a robbery;

(6) Impersonating military or police personnel to commit robbery;

(7) Committing robbery with a firearm;

(8) Robbing military supplies or materials for emergency rescue, disaster relief, or social relief.

Article 264 [Crime of Theft] Whoever steals public or private property, if the amount is relatively large, or who engages in multiple thefts, theft from a residence, theft with a weapon, or pickpocketing, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance, and shall also, or shall only, be fined; if the amount is huge or there are other serious circumstances, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined; if the amount is especially huge or there are other especially serious circumstances, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years or life imprisonment, and shall also be fined or have his or her property confiscated.

Article 266 [Crime of Fraud] Whoever defrauds public or private property, if the amount is relatively large, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance, and shall also, or shall only, be fined; if the amount is huge or there are other serious circumstances, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined; if the amount is especially huge or there are other especially serious circumstances, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years or life imprisonment, and shall also be fined or have his or her property confiscated. Where this Law provides otherwise, such provisions shall apply.

Article 267 [Crime of Snatching] Whoever snatches public or private property, if the amount is relatively large, or who snatches property on multiple occasions, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance, and shall also, or shall only, be fined; if the amount is huge or there are other serious circumstances, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined; if the amount is especially huge or there are other especially serious circumstances, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years or life imprisonment, and shall also be fined or have his or her property confiscated.

Article 271 [Crime of Embezzlement] Where an employee of a company, enterprise, or other unit, by taking advantage of his or her position, unlawfully takes possession of the property of the unit, if the amount is relatively large, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention; if the amount is huge, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years, and may also have his or her property confiscated.

Article 274 [Crime of Extortion] Whoever extorts public or private property, if the amount is relatively large or the extortion is committed on multiple occasions, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance, and shall also, or shall only, be fined; if the amount is huge or there are other serious circumstances, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined; if the amount is especially huge or there are other especially serious circumstances, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years, and shall also be fined.

Article 277 [Crime of Obstructing Official Duties] Whoever, by violence or threat, obstructs a functionary of a State organ from lawfully performing his or her duties shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, public surveillance, or a fine.

Whoever, by violence or threat, obstructs a deputy to the National People's Congress or a deputy to a local people's congress at any level from lawfully performing his or her duties as a deputy shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.

Whoever, during a natural disaster or an unexpected incident, by violence or threat, obstructs a staff member of the Red Cross Society from lawfully performing his or her duties shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 1.

Whoever intentionally obstructs a State security organ or a public security organ from lawfully performing its tasks of maintaining State security, without resorting to violence or threat, causing serious consequences, shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 1.

Whoever violently assaults a people's police officer who is lawfully performing his or her duties shall be given a heavier punishment in accordance with the provisions of paragraph 1.

Article 292 [Crime of Assembling a Crowd to Engage in Affray] Whoever assembles a crowd to engage in affray shall, with respect to the ringleader and other active participants, be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance; in any of the following circumstances, the ringleader and other active participants shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years:

(1) Assembling a crowd to engage in affray on multiple occasions;

(2) Assembling a crowd to engage in affray with a large number of participants, on a large scale, and with adverse social impact;

(3) Assembling a crowd to engage in affray in a public place or on a major traffic route, causing serious chaos in social order;

(4) Assembling a crowd to engage in affray while carrying weapons.

Article 293 [Crime of Picking Quarrels and Provoking Trouble] Whoever engages in any of the following acts of picking quarrels and provoking trouble, thereby disrupting social order, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years, criminal detention, or public surveillance:

(1) Beating another at will, where the circumstances are flagrant;

(2) Chasing, intercepting, insulting, or intimidating another, where the circumstances are flagrant;

(3) Forcibly taking or arbitrarily damaging or occupying public or private property, where the circumstances are serious;

(4) Creating a disturbance in a public place, causing serious chaos in the order of the public place.

Whoever gathers others to repeatedly commit the acts in the preceding paragraph, seriously disrupting social order, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years, and may also be fined.

Article 312 [Crime of Concealing or Disguising Criminal Proceeds and the Proceeds Thereof] Whoever knowingly harbors, transfers, acquires, sells on behalf, or conceals or disguises by other means criminal proceeds and the proceeds generated therefrom shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance, and shall also, or shall only, be fined; if the circumstances are serious, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and shall also be fined.

Article 347 [Crime of Smuggling, Trafficking, Transporting, and Manufacturing Drugs] Whoever smuggles, traffics, transports, or manufactures drugs, regardless of the quantity, shall be investigated for criminal liability and punished criminally.

Whoever smuggles, traffics, transports, or manufactures drugs, in any of the following circumstances, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of fifteen years, life imprisonment, or death, and shall also have his or her property confiscated:

(1) Smuggling, trafficking, transporting, or manufacturing 1,000 grams or more of opium, 50 grams or more of heroin or methamphetamine, or a large quantity of other drugs;

(2) Being the ringleader of a drug smuggling, trafficking, transporting, or manufacturing group;

(3) Armed escort for smuggling, trafficking, transporting, or manufacturing drugs;

(4) Violently resisting inspection, detention, or arrest, where the circumstances are serious;

(5) Participating in organized international drug trafficking activities.

Whoever smuggles, traffics, transports, or manufactures 200 grams or more but less than 1,000 grams of opium, 10 grams or more but less than 50 grams of heroin or methamphetamine, or a relatively large quantity of other drugs shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than seven years, and shall also be fined.

Whoever smuggles, traffics, transports, or manufactures less than 200 grams of opium, less than 10 grams of heroin or methamphetamine, or other small quantities of drugs shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or public surveillance, and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are serious, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than seven years, and shall also be fined.

Where a unit commits any of the crimes in paragraphs 2, 3, and 4, the unit shall be fined, and the persons directly in charge and other persons directly responsible shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of the respective paragraphs.

Whoever uses or incites minors to smuggle, traffic, transport, or manufacture drugs, or sells drugs to minors, shall be given a heavier punishment.

For multiple acts of smuggling, trafficking, transporting, or manufacturing drugs that have not been dealt with, the quantity of drugs shall be calculated cumulatively.
